verdict.rationale: The official Svelte GitHub README tells developers they "may view our roadmap if you'd like to see what we're currently working on," which is a first-party public roadmap matching the story's core. The evidence is a single README mention, though, with no detail on the roadmap's contents, format or how current it is. Missing for 10: description of the roadmap's content and update cadence, independent or hands-on corroboration that it reflects current core-team work.
